description: Implementation of quic_stream.cc, defining the QuicStream class and related functions for managing QUIC stream data, flow control, and stream state transitions.

classes.name: QuicStream
classes.description: Represents a QUIC stream, managing data transmission, flow control, and stream state.

classes.name: PendingStream
classes.description: Represents a pending QUIC stream before it is fully established, handling initial flow control and frame processing.

methods.name: OnStreamFrame
methods.description: Handles incoming stream frames, updating stream state and flow control.

methods.name: OnStreamReset
methods.description: Handles stream reset frames, updating stream state accordingly.

methods.name: OnWindowUpdateFrame
methods.description: Processes window update frames to adjust flow control windows.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the stream with a specified error code.

methods.name: CloseReadSide
methods.description: Closes the read side of the stream.

methods.name: CloseWriteSide
methods.description: Closes the write side of the stream.

methods.name: WriteOrBufferData
methods.description: Writes or buffers application data to the stream.

methods.name: WriteBufferedData
methods.description: Attempts to write buffered data to the network.

methods.name: OnCanWrite
methods.description: Called when the stream is ready to write more data.

methods.name: HasBufferedData
methods.description: Checks if there is buffered data to send.

methods.name: CanWriteNewData
methods.description: Determines if new data can be written based on flow control.

methods.name: SetPriority
methods.description: Sets the priority of the stream.

methods.name: GetSendWindow
methods.description: Returns the current send window size.

methods.name: UpdateReceiveWindowSize
methods.description: Updates the receive window size for flow control.

methods.name: OnStreamCreatedFromPendingStream
methods.description: Initializes a stream from a pending stream.
